prompt:
here's a 30-day onboarding plan for our new junior backend engineer! we need to get them up to speed quickly and set them up for success. can you help me create a phased roadmap that includes:

* week 1: get them set up with a local dev environment, and have them submit their first pr (pull request). we'll pair them with a mentor and assign some easy tasks to get them started.
* week 2-3: have them start working on some small projects, maybe even a simple feature or bug fix. we'll keep an eye on their progress and provide feedback and guidance.
* week 4-5: start bringing them into the fold with more challenging tasks and introducing them to the rest of the team.
* week 6-30: have them work on some bigger projects, maybe even a small feature or two. we'll keep an eye on their progress and provide feedback and guidance.

let's also include some self-assessment goals for them to work on each week, like learning a new skill or improving their code quality. and, of course, we'll make sure the workload is manageable and doesn't lead to burnout.
intended_requirements: local environment setup and first PR in week 1
